title: Disc sighting on a Blue Ridge mountain
place_text: Blue Ridge Mountains near Boone, North Carolina

tellings.quote: And um I look up and that same craft, well, it looked the same. I can't say it was the same one uh that I saw on when I was a kid, when I was eight. Now I'm 18. Just turned 18. Appears in the afternoon sky, crystal clear October day.

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for governments to reveal what they know about UFOs, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that on a crystal clear October afternoon in 1973, when he had just turned 18, he looked up on a mountain in the Blue Ridge range near Boone, North Carolina, and saw a disc-shaped craft. He says it looked like the one he had seen as an eight-year-old, though he cannot say it was the same one.
